releases.notes:
Wall braziers now grow and turn corners, and fire pits grow with a click.

**NOT AN OFFICIAL MINECRAFT PRODUCT. NOT APPROVED BY OR ASSOCIATED WITH MOJANG OR MICROSOFT.**

## What's new in 1.1.0

- **Grow a fire pit by clicking.** With a brazier in hand, click the side of a floor brazier to place another one beside it, joined to the same pit.
- **Extend wall runs.** Click the end or the front of a wall brazier to place the next one along the wall. Past the end of the wall, the run carries on straight out over open space.
- **Wall runs turn corners.** Where two walls meet, the corner brazier joins both runs into one L-shaped trough. Round a block's outside edge, such as a pillar, the run wraps the corner when both faces have wall braziers.
- Sneak-click still places a brazier against the face you click, as before.

## Requirements

- Minecraft: Java Edition **26.3**
- [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/) **0.19.5** or newer
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) for 26.3 (built and tested with 0.163.0+26.3)

## Install or update

Put `mcbraziers-1.1.0.jar` and Fabric API in your `mods` folder, then start the Fabric 26.3 profile. **If you're updating, remove `mcbraziers-1.0.0.jar` first**; Fabric won't start with both. Worlds from 1.0.0 load as they are. On a server, update the server and every player's game. Full steps are in the [README](https://github.com/DalL337/mcbraziers#install).

## Checksum

releases.notes:
The first release of MC Braziers: metal braziers in a vanilla+ style, for Minecraft 26.3 on Fabric.

**NOT AN OFFICIAL MINECRAFT PRODUCT. NOT APPROVED BY OR ASSOCIATED WITH MOJANG OR MICROSOFT.**

## Requirements

- Minecraft: Java Edition **26.3**
- [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/) **0.19.5** or newer
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) for 26.3 (built and tested with 0.163.0+26.3)

## Install

Put `mcbraziers-1.0.0.jar` and Fabric API in your `mods` folder, then start the Fabric 26.3 profile. On a server, install both on the server and on every player's game. Full steps are in the [README](https://github.com/DalL337/mcbraziers#install).

## What's in 1.0.0

- Six tiers (copper, iron, diamond, obsidian, prismarine, netherite), each with its own perk: faster cooking, explosion-proof, water-proof.
- Four fire types (orange, green, purple, blue), set by the campfire you craft with, including the new Copper Campfire and Amethyst Campfire.
- Floor, wall and hanging placement. Floor braziers have an open or closed grate, and neighbouring braziers join into fire pits.
- Closed braziers cook like campfires.
- Copper braziers age and can be waxed. Crying obsidian is a cosmetic variant of the obsidian tier.
- Placeable diamond, obsidian, crying obsidian, prismarine and netherite bars.

readmeSummary: A Fabric mod for Minecraft that adds metal braziers in a vanilla+ style. A brazier is a campfire held in a cage of bars: the bars set its tier, and the campfire sets its fire type.
